ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed ADV 450 should not register for ADV 390. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Non-Advertising majors that have been accepted into the PR Certificate program AND that have completed ADV 150 should visit http://illinois.edu/fb/sec/4727686 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Space is limited and seats will be granted on a first come/first served basis only. If available, seats will open to the College of Media majors on Nov. 17 and to Campus on Nov. 21.
